# HexPiece 3.7.8

Transformed means fruit only. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass.

## No Style while transformed
"In no ZOAN transformed state can you switch to Style or any other mode aside from fruit. (Tori, gear 5, dragon, etc)."
- While you are the dragon, the phoenix or in Gear 5 (from the moment the change starts until you are fully back), tapping R no longer
  takes you into your fighting style. The action bar says "Transformed: only the fruit's moves until you change back".
- The Gomu fruit's own mode key (the one that switches Devil Fruit mode and Haki mode) is refused the same way during Gear 5: you stay
  in Devil Fruit mode.
- The server checks it too, and if a fighting stance is somehow on while you are transformed, it is dropped.
- Ctrl + R (Armament Haki) is not a mode and still works as before. Holding R to turn every power off still works.
- The Leopard fruit's form will follow the same rule when it comes.
